title: Biomedical Science
subject: Life Sciences
summary: Study the science behind human health and disease, and how illnesses are diagnosed in the lab.
description: You learn how the body works and what happens in disease, with lots of time in the lab using diagnostic techniques.
Accredited courses can lead to registration as a biomedical scientist working in NHS labs.
entryRequirements: A-levels or equivalent Level 3, including Biology or Chemistry
GCSE English and Maths at grade 4/C or above
